entries.subject: feat(users): per-user withdrawal wager-requirement override card
entries.body:
Add a card to the user-detail Account tab (right after Custom Battle
Limits) showing the site default, the per-user override, and the
effective multiplier (x + bps). Admins can set a custom override via
dialog, quick-exempt a user (0x = no requirement, bonus included), or
clear the override to fall back to the default. Mutations go through
the backend API behind requireAdmin(), audit old to new, map 404 to
"User not found in backend" and network errors to "Backend not
updated yet". Data is fetched non-critically (own try/catch to null,
NOT in the heavy getUserDetailCached aggregate) and threaded
data->UserViewModern->AccountTab; null degrades the card to its
"awaiting backend deploy" state. Also threaded through the classic
tab-content AccountTabContent and the responsive fixture.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

entries.subject: feat(security): manage withdrawal wager-requirement defaults
entries.body:
Add a defaults card to /security that edits the 5 site-wide
withdrawal wager-requirement knobs (deposit/bonus requirements +
per-game pack/battle/upgrader weights) in x-multipliers with a live
"= N bps" hint. Saves through the backend API (validates + refreshes
its own cache), sends only changed fields, and audits old to new.
The 5 site_config keys are added to the movedKeys filter so the
generic config table no longer double-edits them. Backend read is
non-critical (try/catch to null) so /security never crashes when the
wager-requirement branch isn't deployed — the card shows a muted
"awaiting backend deploy" state.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

entries.subject: feat(backend-api): add PUT support + wager-requirement API module
entries.body:

wager-requirements.ts module wrapping the backend's withdrawal
wager-requirement admin endpoints: defaults GET/PUT and per-user
GET/PUT(set)/DELETE(clear), all in bps (10000 = 1x). Errors surface
as BackendApiError / BackendNetworkError so callers can degrade.
